title: Wireless Redstone
description: Wireless Redstone is a Minecraft addon that lets players send redstone signals without physical wiring. Using wireless transmitters and receivers, players can create cleaner builds, hidden mechanisms, compact farms, remote traps, and advanced automation.
body:
Wireless Redstone is a lightweight but powerful Minecraft addon that completely changes how players build contraptions, bases, traps, and automation systems. Instead of relying on long lines of messy redstone dust, players can connect devices wirelessly across walls, underground tunnels, or even entire bases. The addon introduces customizable wireless transmitters and receivers that sync together instantly, allowing redstone signals to travel without physical connections.

Perfect for survival servers, technical builds, roleplay maps, and secret bases, Wireless Redstone makes complex engineering far cleaner and more creative. Players can create hidden doors with no visible wiring, activate traps remotely, build compact farms, or design futuristic control rooms with ease. Each transmitter can be paired to specific receivers using configurable channels, preventing interference and allowing massive multi-system setups.

The addon is designed to feel balanced and vanilla-friendly while still adding modern functionality to Minecraft. Recipes are intuitive, performance impact is minimal, and setups are easy for beginners while still offering depth for advanced redstone engineers. Whether you are creating stealth security systems, adventure maps, puzzle mechanics, or giant automated factories, Wireless Redstone opens up entirely new possibilities for creativity and technical gameplay.

With multiplayer support, seamless integration into survival worlds, and endless building potential, Wireless Redstone transforms the way players think about automation. Build cleaner, smarter, and more advanced creations without the limitations of traditional redstone wiring.
